scope: Bounded independent review of the frozen 15-input archive-admission candidate, synthetic tests and stated limitations only. No extraction/controller/acquisition/trial execution or adoption authority.

assessments.subject: Trusted artifact identity
assessments.assessment: Accepted algorithm, lowercase digest shape and positive bounded exact byte count are checked; whole input identity is verified before parsing. Hash equality is expected-byte identity, not publisher provenance.

assessments.subject: Lexical paths and inventory consistency
assessments.assessment: Rejects drive/ADS/backslash/absolute/traversal/non-NFC/reserved names, sanitized ZIP names, duplicate and case-sensitive parent spelling conflicts, and either-order file-parent collisions. These are lexical controls only; filesystem ownership, alias/reparse/8.3 containment and later immutable use remain caller obligations.

assessments.subject: Member type and complete declared payload reads
assessments.assessment: ZIP permits stored/deflated nonencrypted regular/directory entries only and reads through stdlib local-name/overlap/CRC handling. TAR admits parsed regular/directory entries, denies links/special/sparse types and reads declared regular payloads. No extraction API is called. Report is returned only after complete admitted-member processing. This does not establish a strict all-byte TAR grammar, compression-trailer validation, provenance or safe destination writes.

assessments.subject: Resource accounting and limits
assessments.assessment: Declared archive/expanded/member/path byte caps and cooperative deadline are implemented. Metadata parsers can allocate or decompress before per-entry checks; deadline is checked at cooperative boundaries. No hard resource quota, hostile stream protection or operating-system containment is claimed.

assessments.subject: Tests and preserved failures
assessments.assessment: All 15 independently replayed test methods pass on existing Python 3.14.5. Synthetic expected payload hashes, malformed inputs, semantic size/path boundaries and denied operations exercise the helper boundary without mirroring its algorithm. Initial 13-method run with seven failing subcases and subsequent evidence-capture failure remain preserved; corrected evidence does not hide them. The suite is proportionate candidate evidence, not exhaustive malicious-archive assurance or Python 3.15 qualification.

assessments.subject: Authority and parent-plan fidelity
assessments.evidence: preparation-contract-v1.json; qualification-plan-v1.json steps02/06/07/09/12, execution_preparation_gate; AGENTS.md workflow approval gates
assessments.assessment: Candidate remains an inspection subset. ZIP RECORD/wheel metadata/native-member checks, catalogue comparison, ownership/extraction, acquisition, reservations, process control, concrete graphs, exact execution permission and later results/adoption are expressly separate. Parent execution_authorized remains false. PASS does not authorize any of those actions.

limitations: No network, new runtime, package installation, extraction, archive-supplied code import/execution, application/Figma/account/provider/Git or canonical-document changes.
No hard parser memory/CPU bound or trusted-stream/target ownership proof; no full archive grammar or compressed envelope integrity certificate.
No selected complete compatibility graph, Python 3.15 execution result, cryptographic provenance, legal/security clearance, integrated Phase 1 acceptance or founder approval.
Receipt status DOING does not claim task DONE or a commit; only this receipt is written.
